The '''octuptarra''' was a tall vine walker native to the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Skako/Legends|Skako]]. The [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] adopted the name for its tripodal [[Octuptarra combat tri-droid/Legends|Octuptarra combat tri-droids]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

The octuptarra itself was an eight-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] creature with a gasbag-shaped head. These vine walkers had numerous legs sprouting from their bodies, and had evolved to survive in the high-pressure [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] that forced the native Skakoans to wear specialized [[Pressure suit/Legends|pressure suits]] on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] with a low-pressure atmosphere. Skakoans kept octuptarras as family pets.
